name: Halluminate

modes.label: Native product; see regime notes
modes.note: Incomplete or non-resource economics: rates remain null, never interpreted as free.

caveats: YC and site describe realistic managed sandbox environment catalog plus datasets/evaluations for labs. Public enterprise product, not necessarily public self-serve API; pricing custom/unverified. Training data fees not compute rental.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

2026-09-29: positioning is 'RL environments for financial services' for frontier AI labs (computer-use/tool-use gyms of enterprise/financial software, Westworld simulated websites, expert-authored tasks). No self-serve API, pricing, quotas, isolation, regions or compliance published; /pricing and /docs 404.
